g.text: R208/R209 => 4.992 V ideal; R207 => about 303 kHz. Ripple injection / passives are NOT dimensioned.

g.desc: R208/R209 => 4.992 V ideal; R207 => about 303 kHz. Ripple injection / passives are NOT dimensioned.

g.text: LM74900 EP / RTN must FLOAT. Do not connect its exposed pad to GND (E05).

g.desc: LM74900 EP / RTN must FLOAT. Do not connect its exposed pad to GND (E05).

g.text: INH is HV logic, not a source for MCU. Main FET path must be ON before buck inrush; R217/C217 remain TBD.

g.desc: INH is HV logic, not a source for MCU. Main FET path must be ON before buck inrush; R217/C217 remain TBD.

g.text: Sleep bypass is for the CAN always-on load only. It is not a startup supply for MCU/display.

g.desc: Sleep bypass is for the CAN always-on load only. It is not a startup supply for MCU/display.

g.text: C201 / C202 are per E05. All voltage ratings, surge stress and UV/OV resistor ladder remain under review.

g.desc: C201 / C202 are per E05. All voltage ratings, surge stress and UV/OV resistor ladder remain under review.

g.text: OPEN: sleep OCP latch-off may remove CAN VSUP/INH. EN tied to VS is NOT independent fault recovery.

g.desc: OPEN: sleep OCP latch-off may remove CAN VSUP/INH. EN tied to VS is NOT independent fault recovery.

g.text: Complete recovery architecture and test fault return before build; the RC wake delay alone is insufficient.

g.desc: Complete recovery architecture and test fault return before build; the RC wake delay alone is insufficient.

g.text: Common-drain topology from E05. Capacitor voltage ratings / passive values with H are engineering assumptions.
